name: Only 3x3's in Academyium Bangalore 2025

venue.name: Academyium
venue.address: 42, 31st Main Road, ITI Layout, 1st Phase, J.P. Nagar, Bengaluru-560078, Karnataka

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Only3x3sinAcademyium2025#59328-competitor-responsibilities)

Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue
